body: **Foco:** Subjunctive constructions — introdução.
**Verbos:** link.
**Pronúncia:** Expressividade.
**22 palavras novas** (problemas sociais).
**Texto do dia:** biografia.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar o subjuntivo (suggest that he go, it is essential that she be, if I were) em uma biografia e entender o verbo link.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.name: Tomás Reyes (fictional human-rights lawyer)
paras: Tomás Reyes insisted that the court **be** open to the public. When colleagues **suggested that he settle** quietly, he refused. “It is essential that every voice **be heard**,” he wrote, “and that no family **be** left without help.”

His clinic **links** students with families in need. He demanded that the city **provide** free translation, and **recommended that** each case **be reviewed** within a month. If he **were** a judge, he joked, he would **require** that lawyers speak plainly.

items.q: Reyes wanted the court closed to the public.
He suggested a month for reviewing each case.
His clinic separates students from families.

head: Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: suggest / insist / demand / recommend + that + sujeito + base
He insisted that the court **be** open.
It is essential / vital / important + that + base
It is essential that every voice **be heard**.
He demanded that no one **not** be heard ✗ / that **no** family **be** left ✓

blocks.body: No **subjuntivo** o verbo fica na **forma base**, sem -s e sem tempo: *he suggested that she **go***, *it is vital that he **be** present*.
No inglês americano o subjuntivo é comum: *I suggest that he **go***. No britânico também se ouve *should go*.

items.s: He insisted that the court ___ open. (be)
It is essential that every voice ___ heard. (be)
She recommended that each case ___ reviewed. (be)
If I ___ a judge, I would require plain speech. (be, were)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Leave no stone unturned.** — Não deixar pedra sobre pedra.
**Plead one’s case** — Defender seu caso
**Beyond reasonable doubt** — Além de dúvida razoável
**Stand trial** — Ser julgado
**Lay down the law** — Impor regras
**Rule in favour of…** — Decidir a favor de…
**Set a precedent** — Abrir um precedente
**Fight for justice** — Lutar por justiça
**What did Reyes suggest?** — O que Reyes sugeriu?
**And he insisted on what?** — E ele insistiu em quê?
**He suggested that each case be reviewed within a month.** — Sugeriu que cada caso fosse revisado em um mês.

items.label: Expressividade
items.note: Ênfase intencional: a palavra mais importante da frase recebe o acento mais forte e a nota mais alta, para marcar contraste ou correção.
words: It was the POLICY, not the person.
We need MORE time, not more money.

prompts.q: Make a suggestion with the subjunctive.
prompts.model: I suggest that he apply today.
It is essential that she be present.

prompts.q: Make a wish about an unreal situation.
prompts.model: I wish the process were shorter.

blocks.task: Write 5 sentences using the subjunctive after suggest, insist, demand and it is essential that.
blocks.model: I suggest that she see a lawyer. He insisted that the hearing be public. The union demanded that no worker be dismissed. It is essential that the report be accurate. If I were the mayor, I would require that every meeting be open.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
